pmlr-v267-li25bx: its global-order premise is sufficient for greedy success, but it gives no smooth ANM separating that premise from a local correcting-move guarantee.
reisach2023scale: analyzes population R² behavior in ANM chains, but not the exact GENE residual-dependence penalty or this two-node gain calculation.

reisach2023scale and pmlr-v267-li25bx: neither constructs a relatively open smooth identifiable ANM family with a strict wrong-order GENE local maximum.
pfister2018dhsic and shekhar2023permutationfree: they treat kernel-independence testing, not simultaneous learned-risk/residual-HSIC bands propagated through adaptive GENE recovery into a graph set.

soundness_flags.label: ass:smooth-positive-densities
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Peters restricted-ANM condition requires strictly positive noise densities, whereas compact-support positivity only on a relative interior is a new replacement and must be retagged novel and justified as such.

soundness_flags.label: ass:condition19-configurations
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Definition 27 requires a positive-density conditioning point satisfying Condition 19; the compact interior/open-part reformulation is stronger and nonstandard as stated, so it cannot retain the standard tag without a compact-support source.

soundness_flags.label: ass:characteristic-kernels
soundness_flags.one_line: Pfister et al. support bounded continuous characteristic kernels, but not the added Lipschitz-in-residual requirement; split or separately cite/justify that perturbation condition.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 5, Equation (6), Definitions 4.1--4.2, and Theorem 4.3; p. 6 proof sketch.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: GENE uses an R² score with residual-independence penalties; Theorem 4.3 assumes that every order with lower Rev has strictly larger fitness and concludes greedy order search reaches a true order.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 12, model (6) and Definition 15; pp. 13--16, Condition 19, Definition 27, and Theorem 28.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper's ANM formulation uses jointly independent noises with strictly positive densities; Definition 27 requires a conditioning value with positive density satisfying Condition 19, and Theorem 28 gives identification under causal minimality.
For iid edge weights with finite positive E[log|V|] and bounded positive noise-scale support, the terminal-node R² in an increasing-length linear causal chain converges almost surely to one.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2.2.1, Setting 1 and Proposition 1; Appendix-E discussion of Theorem E.2 and Proposition E.3.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source uses continuous bounded characteristic tensor-product kernels and discusses fitted-residual asymptotics/sample splitting, but does not state a Lipschitz-in-residual-coordinate kernel condition.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1 and 6--16, model statement, HSIC setup, and null-limit results.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies iid bivariate independence and derives permutation-free cross-HSIC asymptotics under its own kernel and moment conditions; it does not provide adaptive GENE graph-set inference with learned residuals.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag the compact interior-density and compact Condition-19 adaptations as novel, supply their compact-support justifications, and cite a separate source or lemma for the connected-fiber intersection argument.

Split the kernel condition into Pfister-supported bounded-characteristic assumptions and a separately sourced Lipschitz residual-stability condition; then state exactly where the latter enters the HSIC band rate.

Add a theorem-level corollary that compares the primitive matching-component certificate with Li et al.'s global premise on the common class, explicitly isolating the strict inclusion witnessed by the six-node construction.

recommended_next_step: Revise the three inaccurately standard-tagged assumptions and their literature support; the field-tier local-navigation and strict-Li-separation kernel can then advance to Stage 0.
